title: The Spire
_todo: Panel art and portraits are made by the art agent (docs/levels/08-the-spire.md 9.1, 9.2). Voice lines do not exist yet.

panels.shot: Extreme low angle. The Spire rises into black storm clouds. Lightning lights its glass clock crown; the hands read 11:40. The hero stands at the base, tiny, in the rain. Nero sits at his heel.

lines.text: Every road in Valmora leads up. Tonight, so did mine.

panels.shot: The mirrored marble lobby. A hundred reflections of the hero. Dozens of Choir men in black tie turn toward him at once. Every lapel has a silver tuning-fork pin (red tint).

lines.text: The whole Choir. All its voices, in one room.

panels.shot: Close-up. The hero loads the shotgun. A raindrop falls from his hair onto the shell.
Flashback, sepia: the young hero and Bell in the old workshop. Bell corrects the boy's left guard with a ruler. Clocks tick on every wall.

lines.speaker: Bell
lines.text: Time is everything, boy. Strike when the bell rings.
